title: Most Adults Cannot Pass This Teacher's Entrance Exam
summary: Ten questions test classroom judgment, assessment, safeguarding and teaching essentials.

landing.intro: The first classroom questions seem obvious. Then the test moves into assessment, safeguarding and decisions every teacher must get right.

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment challenge uses broad classroom concepts that apply across Tier 1 English-speaking countries. It moves from checking understanding and responding to mistakes into assessment, communication, safeguarding and professional judgment.

Choose one answer for each question. Correctness stays hidden until the final reveal, where the complete answer review is available to unlock.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Answer ten increasingly difficult classroom questions.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an accredited teacher-training, admission or employment exam. Safeguarding procedures and professional requirements vary by location; follow the rules that apply where you work.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked and your classroom aptitude score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Classroom Standout
profile-1.copy: You balanced learning, communication and professional judgment with exceptional accuracy. Even the final integrity question stayed clear.

profile-2.title: The Teacher-Level Thinker
profile-2.copy: You passed a challenge that defeats most adults. Your classroom decisions stayed strong from the opening check to the final question.

profile-3.title: The Sharp Educator
profile-3.copy: You built a strong result across a demanding mix of teaching skills. A few professional details kept the pass mark just out of reach.

profile-4.title: The Promising Candidate
profile-4.copy: The classroom foundations clicked, while assessment and safeguarding proved tougher. The review explains every missed answer.

profile-5.title: The First-Round Applicant
profile-5.copy: This challenge moved beyond school-day basics quickly. Your strongest area shows where your teaching instincts already have a solid beginning.

teacher-q1.question: Which approach gives a teacher the clearest quick picture of whether the whole class understood a new idea?
answers: A brief check in which every learner responds
Asking only the quickest volunteer
Waiting until the end-of-term report
Repeating the explanation without checking

teacher-q2.question: A learner gives an incorrect answer. Which response is most likely to support learning?
answers: Move immediately to someone else
Ask them to explain their thinking, then guide them with focused questions
Announce the correct answer and continue
Avoid returning to the idea

teacher-q3.question: What is the usual name for assessment used during learning to help adjust teaching?
answers: Final assessment
Entry assessment
Formative assessment
Attendance assessment

teacher-q4.question: A learner discloses information suggesting they may be at risk of harm. What is the best general response?
answers: Promise complete secrecy
Investigate the entire situation alone
Wait to see whether they mention it again
Listen calmly, avoid promising secrecy and follow the appropriate safeguarding procedure

teacher-q5.question: Which learning objective asks learners to make the most complex judgment?
answers: Compare two explanations and support a conclusion with evidence
Copy three definitions
List the days of the week
Underline every heading

teacher-q6.question: A class has 30 learners working in equal groups of 5. How many groups are needed?

teacher-q7.question: What does differentiated instruction most accurately involve?
answers: Giving every learner completely different subject content
Lowering expectations for the entire class
Adapting access, support or challenge while keeping meaningful learning goals
Allowing only confident learners to answer

teacher-q8.question: When is an assessment described as reliable?
answers: When it contains the greatest number of questions
When every learner receives a high mark
When it can be completed quickly
When it produces reasonably consistent results under similar conditions

teacher-q9.question: Which instruction is most likely to help learners begin a new task successfully?
answers: Give a short sequence, model an example and check understanding
Explain every possible exception before stating the task
Write one vague sentence and begin immediately
Ask learners to guess the success criteria

teacher-q10.question: Which description best defines plagiarism?
answers: Revising a draft after feedback
Presenting another person's words or ideas as your own without acknowledgement
Using more than one source
Disagreeing with an author's conclusion
